chunks: (Regarding) Allah Mighty and Majestic: 'and the witnesses should not refuse when they are summoned' — so he (AS) said: 'It is not befitting for anyone who is summoned to testify upon something he has witnessed that he should say: I will not testify for you.'
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (AS)
similar to it, and said: 'So that is before the writing (documentation).'

key_terms.الشُّهَدَاء: the witnesses; those summoned to testify to a transaction, contract, or legal matter
key_terms.الْكِتَاب: the writing/document; refers to the formal written record of a debt or transaction as prescribed in Quran 2:282
key_terms.شَهَادَة: testimony; the formal act of witnessing in an Islamic legal context, with binding obligations once accepted

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about a witness who refuses to testify when summoned?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a second chain of narration, transmitted through Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Qummi, corroborating the ruling that witnesses must not refuse to testify when summoned. The Imam's added remark — 'that is before the writing' — addresses Quran 2:282 (the longest verse in the Quran, legislating the recording of debts) and clarifies that the witness's duty to appear arises at the stage prior to formal documentation. Early Muslim scholars understood this to mean that the obligation to respond and be counted as a witness applies when testimony is being gathered — not after the written document has already been prepared, at which point a witness's role may have already been fulfilled.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:282] and the witnesses should not refuse when they are summoned. So heasws said: ‘It is not befitting for anyone when he is summoned to testify upon what he had witnessed, that he should be saying, ‘I shall not testify for you’.
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Halby,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, similar to it, and said: ‘So that is before the writing (documenting)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu al-Sabbah al- Kinaniy who has narrated the following: “About the meaning of the words of Allah, ‘. . . the witnesses must not refuse to testify when they are summoned to testify,’ [2:282] abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is not proper for one who is called to testify to what he has witnessed to say, “I do not want to testify for you.’”

” Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from al-Halabiy from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, a similar Hadith and said that it is before the documentation.
